messages:
katie: quick thing — I'm prototyping a console control to 'dampen' noisy alerts per-route. idea: allow a short moving window that scales down notify severity if alert rate spikes but SLO burn is low. thoughts? :thinking_face:
rafael: can you sketch the UX? is this per-tenant or per-route?
katie: per-route default, override per-tenant. UI would show 'dampen' knob (0-100%) + window (1m/5m/15m) + sample preview. backend maps to policy: {damping_window, suppression_weight, escalation_threshold}
devon: curious how this interacts with error budgets — we shouldn't hide real burn. maybe repo policy should expose expected SLO impact estimate in preview.
katie: yep, preview includes 'estimated error-budget impact' and 'alert volume delta' plus cost estimate for notification recipients.
selina: love the cost estimate. ops asked for routing to go down the severity ladder (pager -> slack -> ticket) based on noise score. can we wire that to routing policies?
katie: plan: routing policy has new field `noise_mode: dynamic` which consumes a noise_score (0..1) and maps to notify_tier. config example:

```
routes:
  - name: model-infer-5xx
    noise_mode: dynamic
    damping_window: 5m
    mapping:
      noise_score >= 0.8: notify: slack
      noise_score < 0.8: notify: pager
```

maya: small ask — keep a 'force notify' toggle in the UI for exec pages so we can bypass damping during incidents.
rafael: +1, also need audit log for every auto-damped event. important for postmortems.
katie: we'll append an 'audit_marker' event to the trace for any suppressed notification.
tony: ops-bot suggestion: add a synthetic 'signal-to-noise' metric we compute from historical true-positives (alerts with SLO burn) vs total alerts. show as a single metric on route card.
selina: could we add an 'adjusted threshold' preview so users can slide target SNR and see how the threshold changes? would help adoption.
katie: good idea. implementation note: threshold_preview = base_threshold * (1 + clamp( (target_snr - current_snr), -0.5, 1.5))
devon: API question — will this be in the existing notify-policy API or a new endpoint? we should avoid breaking clients.
katie: adding optional fields to notify-policy v2 with a compatibility shim. clients ignoring new fields will get current behavior.
ops-bot: deploy: feature-branch/dynamic-damping deployed to staging at 2027-06-08T14:22Z :rocket:
rafael: i'll review the API patch tomorrow, want to ensure the telemetry tag is present so we can track adoption.
katie: thanks — I'll push the draft UI screenshots in the design channel and a small mock server for the preview endpoint.
maya: :thumbsup: try to include sample tenant crossovers in preview (shared routes across tenants) — customers care.
katie: noted. folks, want to sync 30m tomorrow? Can do a quick demo and get engineering + ops signoff.
rafael: yes, 10:30am PT works.
maya: works for me.
selina: me too.
katie: meeting scheduled. will post calendar invite. :calendar:
